{{Quote|Rojo Trace? I'm Captain Tekla Ansgar. Welcome. It's a pleasure to meet you. I certainly hope you won't judge your experience here on the basis of one unpleasant conversation.|Tekla Ansgar to Rojo Trace|<ref name="Red Harvest" />}}
'''Tekla Ansgar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the leader of the team that investigated a crashed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], alongside [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Norch]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rojo Trace]].
